bio.text: Samuel Kane is the Republican nominee for New Mexico Attorney General in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a personal injury attorney based in Las Cruces, where he has lived for more than 20 years after moving from Arizona.
According to Source NM, Kane has run his own law practice since 2004, after clerking for Senior U.S. District Judge Robert C. Brack, and focuses largely on personal injury cases.
